name: Blue Cash Everyday® Card from American Express
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 3% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Missing at least the Minimum Payment Due, or a returned payment; applies for at least 6 months and is reviewed every 6 months after that
pay_over_time_fee: 0% during the first 15 months from account opening, then up to 1.33% per month of each purchase or amount moved into a Plan It plan

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $2,000 in purchases in the first 6 months of Card Membership; welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer

verdict.text: No annual fee: an easy keep if you shop groceries, gas, or online

earn_note: Each 3% category caps at $6,000/yr in spend (max $180/yr per category, $540/yr across all three) before dropping to 1%. Generous for a no-fee card, but track your spend if you're close to a cap.

points.note: Not a points program: cash back here is worth face value, redeemed as a statement credit, at Amazon.com checkout, or as a deposit to an Amex High Yield Savings account. No transfer partners, no premium redemption to chase.

transfer_partners.highlight: Cash back isn't a transferable currency. It's a straight statement credit, always worth face value.

credits.name: Disney Streaming Credit
credits.subtitle: $7/mo · enroll
credits.description: Up to $7/month in statement credits after you use the enrolled card for a subscription at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com, or Stream.ESPN.com. Standalone subscriptions count, not just the bundle, and the old $9.99 minimum monthly spend is gone. Enrollment required.
tips: Only worth it if you already subscribe to one of these services; otherwise it's $0 to you.
The purchase has to run through the U.S. Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN sites and be set to auto-renew. Billing through Apple or Roku won't trigger it.

credits.name: Home Chef Credit
credits.subtitle: $15/mo · enroll
credits.description: Up to $15 a month in statement credits at Home Chef, up to $180 a calendar year. Enrollment required.
tips: Only worth it if you already buy Home Chef meal kits; otherwise it's $0 to you.

protection_note: Thin by design: this is a no-fee cash-back card, not a travel card. No trip delay, trip cancellation, or baggage coverage, and no extended warranty (that's reserved for the paid Blue Cash Preferred tier).
rental_note: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance is included, underwritten by AMEX Assurance. Reserve and pay for the whole rental with the card and decline the counter waiver.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)
Same purchase protection as the primary card

additional_cards.note: Additional cards are free: no reason not to add a trusted household member.
